markers.name: PORTAL_Arrival
markers.note: Arrival point and ejection portal origin.

markers.name: INT_The_Greeting_Vine
markers.note: Shakes your hand. Remembers you next visit.

markers.name: INT_Seed_Bank
markers.note: Plant a seed here and it grows into something over real-world days.

markers.name: INT_The_Carnivore
markers.note: Feed it the wrong thing and it sulks for a week.

markers.name: INT_Pollen_Bell
markers.note: Calls every creature within range. Some of them are pleased about it.

markers.name: INT_The_Compost_Heap
markers.note: Bury an item, come back later, get something stranger.

markers.name: INT_Walking_Tree
markers.note: It is going somewhere. It has been going there for a long time.

markers.name: INT_The_Beehive_Archive
markers.note: The hum is a recording. Of what, is the question.

markers.name: INT_Mushroom_Trampoline
markers.note: Launches you into the canopy. The canopy has its own map.

markers.name: INT_The_Gardener_s_Shed
markers.note: Tools, notes, and a schedule for something that is not gardening.

markers.name: INT_Sap_Still
markers.note: Brews Healing and Hype potions from harvested sap (Part II 36).

markers.name: INT_The_Quiet_Clearing
markers.note: Nothing happens until you stop moving for thirty seconds.

markers.name: INT_The_Cat
markers.note: Not a pet. Leads patient players somewhere worth going.
